text: Welcome to Anecdota!
Anecdota is an interactive learning tool designed for students with different learning needs.
Through stories and choices, you can practice understanding social situations, making decisions, and thinking about what to do next.
Select the Continue button to move forward.
The story appears in this text box.
The sentences will appear one at a time.
Press the Continue button to move forward when you are ready.
Sometimes, the story will ask you a question.
When this happens, choice buttons will appear.
Select the choice that you think is best.
scene3.prompt: Which button should you select to continue the tutorial?

text: Great choice!
Your choices can change what happens in a story.
Take your time and read every option before choosing.
That choice did not continue the tutorial, but that is okay!
You can try the question again.
scene5.prompt: Which button should you select to continue the tutorial?

text: Select the Pause button at any time during a story to open the pause menu.
The story will wait until you choose what to do next.
The pause menu has three options.
Select Resume to return to the story where you left off.
Select Start Over to restart the story from the beginning.
Select Main Menu to leave the story and return to the main menu.
There is no time limit, so you do not need to rush.
You are now ready to explore Anecdota!
Press the button to return to the main menu.
